notes: Reference nameplate power and typical usage for appliances common in NTHU
off-campus rented rooms. VoltSpace uses this table to (1) sanity-check a user's
input, (2) give a rule-based recommendation when a value looks high, and
(3) suggest a more efficient alternative so Member A can run a what-if scenario.
Values are typical ranges collected for a student project, not vendor specs.
Member B can store this same table in PostgreSQL later; the JSON stays the source
of truth for the calculation modules so they remain database-independent.

appliances.efficiency_note_zh: 變頻一級能效機種比定頻機種省電約 30-50%，並建議設定 26-28 度搭配電扇。

efficient_alternative.note_zh: 以相同使用時數估算，較高耗能的舊機種可明顯降低用電量。
efficient_alternative.note_en: At the same usage, an older inefficient unit uses noticeably more electricity.

rules.title_zh: 冷氣每日使用超過 8 小時
rules.title_en: Air conditioner runs more than 8 hours a day
rules.reason_zh: 冷氣是租屋處最常見的高耗電來源，每多吹 1 小時，月用電量就會線性增加。
rules.reason_en: Air conditioning is the biggest electricity user in a rented room. Every extra hour of cooling adds to the monthly total almost linearly.
rules.suggestion_zh: 設定 26-28 度並搭配電風扇或循環扇，睡前使用定時功能，可減少 1-2 小時運轉。
rules.suggestion_en: Set 26-28 °C with a fan or circulator, and use the sleep timer so the unit runs 1-2 hours less.

rules.title_zh: 冷氣額定功率高於一般值
rules.title_en: Air conditioner rated power is above the typical value
rules.reason_zh: 使用者輸入的功率明顯高於同類常見機種，可能是舊型定頻機或較大噸數機種。
rules.reason_en: The wattage entered is clearly higher than comparable units, which usually means an older non-inverter model or a larger tonnage.
rules.suggestion_zh: 汰換為一級能效變頻機種，或縮小使用範圍、加強門窗隔熱與遮光。
rules.suggestion_en: Replace it with a Grade-1 inverter unit, or cool a smaller area and improve insulation and shading.

appliances.efficiency_note_zh: 冰箱全年 24 小時運轉，是「穩定但持續」的耗電來源，老舊機種壓縮機效率差。

efficient_alternative.note_zh: 變頻壓縮機可依負載調整轉速，較定頻機種省電。
efficient_alternative.note_en: An inverter compressor adjusts its speed to the load, so it uses less than a fixed-speed unit.

rules.title_zh: 冰箱為 24 小時運轉電器
rules.title_en: The refrigerator runs 24 hours a day
rules.reason_zh: 每日 24 小時、每月 30 天的運轉時間讓冰箱即使功率不高，月用電量仍容易進入前幾名。
rules.reason_en: Running 24 hours a day, every day, puts the refrigerator near the top of the monthly total even though its wattage is low.
rules.suggestion_zh: 設定冷藏 5-7 度、冷凍 -18 度，避免塞滿影響對流，並與牆面保持 5 公分以上散熱距離。
rules.suggestion_en: Keep the fridge at 5-7 °C and the freezer at -18 °C, do not overfill it, and leave at least 5 cm of clearance behind it for airflow.

appliances.efficiency_note_zh: 儲熱式電熱水器保溫會持續耗電，瞬熱式則瞬間功率極高，兩者都容易造成迴路負載偏高。

efficient_alternative.note_zh: 熱泵效率（COP）遠高於電阻式加熱，但設備成本較高。
efficient_alternative.note_en: Heat pumps are far more efficient than resistive heating, but the equipment costs more.

rules.title_zh: 電熱水器功率極高，注意迴路負載
rules.title_en: Electric water heater draws very high power - mind the circuit
rules.reason_zh: 電熱水器功率常達 4000W 以上，單一電器就可能接近 110V/15A 迴路的上限。
rules.reason_en: Water heaters often draw 4000 W or more, so a single appliance can approach the limit of a 110 V / 15 A circuit.
rules.suggestion_zh: 使用時避免同時開啟其他高功率電器，並確認是否為 220V 專用迴路。
rules.suggestion_en: Do not run other high-power appliances at the same time, and check whether it has its own 220 V circuit.

appliances.efficiency_note_zh: 吹風機使用時間短，總用電量通常不高，但瞬間電流大，是最常見的跳電元凶。

efficient_alternative.note_zh: 降低瓦數可減少瞬時負載，但乾髮時間可能變長。
efficient_alternative.note_en: Lower wattage reduces the momentary load, though drying may take longer.

rules.title_zh: 吹風機是瞬間高負載電器
rules.title_en: The hair dryer is a short, heavy load
rules.reason_zh: 吹風機功率約 1000-1500W，在 110V 下電流約 9-14A，很容易與其他電器同時使用時超過迴路上限。
rules.reason_en: At roughly 1000-1500 W a hair dryer draws about 9-14 A at 110 V, so using it alongside other appliances easily exceeds the circuit limit.
rules.suggestion_zh: 使用吹風機時先關閉電暖器、電鍋或微波爐，並避免使用老舊延長線。
rules.suggestion_en: Turn off the heater, rice cooker or microwave while drying your hair, and avoid old extension cords.

appliances.efficiency_note_zh: 洗衣機主要耗電來自加熱功能；改用冷水洗滌可大幅降低用電。

efficient_alternative.note_zh: 變頻馬達在脫水與低速運轉時較省電。
efficient_alternative.note_en: An inverter motor is more efficient when spinning and at low speed.

rules.reason_zh: 洗衣次數多會累積用電量，若使用熱水洗滌耗電更明顯。
rules.reason_en: Frequent washes add up, and washing with hot water uses noticeably more energy.
rules.suggestion_zh: 集中衣物一次洗、使用冷水洗程並縮短脫水時間。
rules.suggestion_en: Wash a full load at once, use a cold cycle, and keep the spin time short.

appliances.efficiency_note_zh: 含獨立顯卡或高瓦數電源的桌機在遊戲或運算時耗電明顯上升。

efficient_alternative.note_zh: 同等工作時間下，筆電耗電通常僅為桌機的 1/3 至 1/4。
efficient_alternative.note_en: For the same working hours a laptop typically uses a third to a quarter of a desktop's power.

rules.title_en: The computer is on for a long time
rules.reason_zh: 長時間開機（含待機）會累積可觀用電，睡眠模式仍會消耗少量電力。
rules.reason_en: Long uptime - including idle time - accumulates real consumption, and sleep mode still draws a small amount.
rules.suggestion_zh: 開啟睡眠／休眠設定，離開超過 15 分鐘即自動休眠，並關閉不必要的周邊設備電源。
rules.suggestion_en: Enable sleep or hibernate after 15 minutes of inactivity, and switch off peripherals you are not using.

appliances.efficiency_note_zh: 電扇功率低，搭配冷氣使用可在不增加太多用電下提升舒適度。

efficient_alternative.note_zh: DC 馬達較 AC 馬達省電，低速運轉時更明顯。
efficient_alternative.note_en: A DC motor uses less than an AC motor, especially at low speed.

appliances.efficiency_note_zh: LED 燈泡較傳統白熾燈省電約 80%，是投資回收最快的節電方式之一。

efficient_alternative.note_zh: 以相同亮度比較，LED 瓦數遠低於白熾燈或傳統日光燈。
efficient_alternative.note_en: At the same brightness, LEDs draw far less than incandescent bulbs or fluorescent tubes.

rules.reason_zh: 照明時間長時，燈具效率對總用電量的影響會被放大。
rules.reason_en: When lights run for many hours, the efficiency of the fittings dominates the total consumption.
rules.suggestion_zh: 改用 LED 燈泡並養成離開房間隨手關燈的習慣。
rules.suggestion_en: Switch to LED bulbs and turn the lights off whenever you leave the room.

appliances.efficiency_note_zh: 電鍋保溫功能會持續耗電，長時間保溫不經濟。

efficient_alternative.note_zh: 保溫效率較佳，並可縮短保溫時間。
efficient_alternative.note_en: Better keep-warm efficiency, and it can shorten the keep-warm period.

rules.title_zh: 電鍋長時間使用（含保溫）
rules.title_en: The rice cooker is on for a long time (including keep-warm)
rules.reason_zh: 保溫雖然功率較低，但長時間累積的用電量可能超過實際加熱。
rules.reason_en: Keep-warm uses less power, but over many hours it can exceed the energy used for actual cooking.
rules.suggestion_zh: 煮好後盡快食用或改用保溫瓶，減少長時間保溫。
rules.suggestion_en: Eat soon after cooking or use a thermos, and avoid long keep-warm periods.

appliances.efficiency_note_zh: 微波爐加熱效率高、時間短，總用電量通常低於電鍋。

efficient_alternative.note_zh: 加熱效率高可縮短運轉時間。
efficient_alternative.note_en: Better heating efficiency shortens the run time.

appliances.efficiency_note_zh: 電視待機功率低但仍持續消耗，長時間不使用建議關閉電源。

efficient_alternative.note_zh: 新機種面板效率較佳，待機功率也更低。
efficient_alternative.note_en: Newer panels are more efficient and draw less in standby.

appliances.efficiency_note_zh: 電暖器屬於電阻式加熱，1W 電力最多產生 1W 熱能，效率無法再提升，只能減少使用時間。

efficient_alternative.label_zh: 變頻冷暖氣機（暖氣模式）
efficient_alternative.note_zh: 熱泵效率大於 1，同樣熱量下用電量通常低於電暖器。
efficient_alternative.note_en: A heat pump has a coefficient of performance above 1, so it usually uses less than a resistive heater for the same heat.

rules.title_zh: 電暖器為高功率電阻式加熱
rules.title_en: The space heater is a high-power resistive load
rules.reason_zh: 電暖器功率高且效率已達理論上限，只能靠減少使用時間節電。
rules.reason_en: Resistive heaters are already at their theoretical efficiency limit, so the only way to save energy is to run them less.
rules.suggestion_zh: 改用冷暖氣機暖氣模式，或以衣物、地墊保暖並縮小加熱空間。
rules.suggestion_en: Use the heating mode of an air conditioner instead, or warm a smaller space with clothing and a floor mat.
